title: StatusEvent
description: How the device stands: sent on the screen socket after the stream starts, and whenever that changes.

ScopeStatus.description: Whether a scope can have a simulator, why not, how its device stands, and what the viewer is offered. The HTTP status route answers with it.

reason.description: Why the scope cannot have a simulator now; null when it can.

connector.description: The connector that drives devices for this scope; null when none is available.

fallback_reason.description: Why a connector other than the one asked for is in use; null otherwise.

Started.description: A scope's status once its device is being brought up, with a one-shot ticket for its screen socket.

DeviceChoice.description: A device a scope could use, for a device picker: a simulator on this Mac, or a real device connected to it.

state.description: What simctl says of a simulator, such as Booted or Shutdown; Connected or Disconnected for a real device.

kind.description: Whether it is a simulator or a real device. An older server does not send it: read it as simulator.

connection.description: How a real device reaches this Mac; null for a simulator.

detail.description: What a person should know before picking it, such as Locked or Developer Mode off; null when nothing.

usable.description: Whether it can be picked now; detail says why not. An older server does not send it: read it as true.
